key_insight: An AI-derived focal TIL score captures localized lymphocyte infiltration on routine H&E images and was associated with overall survival in ICI-treated lung adenocarcinoma.
clinical_relevance: The score may support accessible prognostic assessment, but this study does not establish its ability to predict benefit from immunotherapy.
method: Detect lymphocytes using a deep learning model trained on IHC-derived ground truth.
Segment tumor and adjacent stroma using a model trained on consensus pathologist annotations.
Quantify tile-level TIL density to capture spatially localized immune infiltration.
evidence_signal: Analytical validation yielded lymphocyte CCC 0.90 and segmentation Dice 0.87; in 685 ICI-treated patients, the score was associated with overall survival (HR 0.60, 95% CI 0.48–0.75; P<0.001) and reportedly outperformed PD-L1.
watch_item: Broader validation is needed before clinical use; an association within an ICI-treated cohort does not establish treatment-specific predictive value.
paper_title: Quantifying Localized Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocytes by Deep Learning on H&E Images: Analytical Validation and Prognostic Value in Lung Adenocarcinoma
